name: Mor'rogal
summary: In Sun Rock Retreat, Mor'rogal guides travelers toward the dangers and promise of the Stonetalon Mountains.

sections.title: Watcher in the Crags
sections.body: Mor'rogal watches the deep crevices and caverns of the Stonetalon Mountains from Sun Rock Retreat. Their twisting passages offer riches, but can also bring deadly danger. He sends brave Horde wanderers to troubled places such as Boulderslide Ravine. To Mor'rogal, facing those depths tests the spirit of anyone who seeks glory by following heart and soul.

faq.answer: Mor'rogal is a tauren guide in Sun Rock Retreat, in the Stonetalon Mountains. He urges Horde travelers to test their mettle in the dangerous caves and ravines scattered across the mountains.
You can find Mor'rogal in Sun Rock Retreat, the main Horde outpost among the peaks of the central Stonetalon Mountains.
Mor'rogal sends capable champions to the cave at Boulderslide Ravine, where kobolds mine Resonite crystals, then asks them to slay Goggeroc, a sleeping Earthen the kobolds dug up.

faq.q: Why is Mor'rogal focused on caves and ravines?
faq.answer: Mor'rogal believes Stonetalon's perilous caverns offer adventure and a test of spiritual resolve, with glory and riches for those willing to risk their lives.

angles.text: As a tauren, you may see the deep stone hollows of Kalimdor as sacred ground, where physical and spiritual trials can prove your worth.
As a member of the Horde arriving at Sun Rock Retreat, you can turn to Mor'rogal for information about threats in the crags beyond the settlement.
